title: Standalone form: a lookupAutofill field still copies an amount across currencies (the guard from #36918 applies only on record forms)
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a data-correctness defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7127028135). Source: an out-of-scope finding from PR #36918, which fixes #36412's cross-currency lookup autofill on the record-form paths.

## What happens

A `form` node rendered on its own (the `@object-ui/components` form renderer, outside a record form) with a field that declares `lookupAutofill` still copies a currency amount from the picked record when the two sides use different currencies. PR #36918 stamps the currency guard on the record-form paths. A standalone form node has nothing that stamps it, so the guard never applies there. The person sees an amount in the wrong currency, filled in without a note, and can save it.

reach: not measured. It reaches authored pages that put a bare form node with `lookupAutofill` on a currency field. The dev counts them first (examples, showcase, HotCRM) and records the count in the PR.

## Expected

A standalone form node applies the same cross-currency guard as a record form when it can know the field's currency. If it cannot, the field's described contract says where the guard holds.

## Acceptance

- Option A (the dev's recommendation): when the form node has `objectName`, it stamps the guard from that object's schema, the same way the record-form paths do. A test pins a cross-currency pick on a standalone form node that copies no amount.
- Option B, only where A cannot apply (no `objectName`): narrow the `FieldSchema.lookupAutofill` description to say the guard holds only where the object schema is known. Keep it consistent with #36349, which states the same rule in `skills/objectstack-data`.
- The PR states which option it took and why.

Dedupe: open issues for `lookupAutofill` return #36412 (the record-form follow-ups that #36918 fixes) and #36349 (skills text). Neither covers the standalone form node.
